messages:
Marta: Heads-up — RivetAnalytics shows a pronounced dip in API calls from RivetAnalytics corp. ~45% lower DAU over 14 days, active seats unchanged. Putting this on the renewal radar.
Sam: Noted. I messaged our main champion last week; they said dev work is paused but didn’t say they're leaving. No procurement activity logged in Salesforce.
Nina: Support: overall tickets low, but backlog of feature requests. Reopened ticket #5421 after PM replied; they called out batch job slowness.
Ethan: Telemetry: after runtime v2.1 rollout in us-west their org saw p95 regressions (long-context paths) ~20%. Could explain lower usage. @eng-runtime should double-check perf matrix.
deploy-bot: Deploy finished: runtime v2.1 -> us-west at 2026-03-18T03:14:22Z (commit ab12f3c).
Leo: I can take a look at the telemetry traces for their org id. If p95 jumps align with the deploy window that's actionable.
Marta: OK — don't jump to credits yet. Plan: 1) quick remediation call with their CTO+PM 2) try non-invasive perf knobs or canary rollback during their low-traffic window 3) collate support + CSAT notes and competitor intel.
Oliver: Also flag that their PM mentioned a CompetitorX trial. I'll prepare a concise comparison (latency/cost/feature parity) we can show on the call.
Sam: I'll coordinate scheduling. Prefer Thu morning PT. Do we want to lead with a remediation plan or open with discovery?
Marta: Start with discovery but have a concrete remediation ready (rollback plan + perf-guidance). If they push on pricing, we can discuss Dedicated/quantization as options.
Nina: Uploaded ticket export and recent NPS snippets to the shared folder: /shared/customer-success/rivetanalytics/exports/2026-03-18. Two earlier "batch slowness" threads in Jan/Feb referenced heavy KV-cache usage.
Ethan: I'll reproduce their payloads in staging (v2.1 vs v2.0) and measure p95. If we can reproduce, suggest a short rollback window or toggle.
Leo: On it. Also checking whether an optimizer change in v2.1 altered attention tiling for long sequences.
Sam: Scheduling poll sent to CTO and PM. Tentative Thu 09:30 PT.
Oliver: Competitor one-pager will be in #cs-briefs EOD tomorrow. I'll include suggested messaging for procurement contacts.
Marta: Action items (summarized): Sam = confirm meeting; Nina = aggregate support history & CSAT; Ethan/Leo = perf repro + rollback swing plan; Oliver = competitor brief & commercial flex options. I'll draft the customer note after Sam confirms. Keep updates here. :spiral_calendar:
